model_annotations.Chinese: The line graph presents a comparison of the average sparsity ratios before and after a gate for three different conditions, as well as the average sparsity ratio after an average gate. The x-axis appears to represent some form of sequential time or event, while the y-axis measures the sparsity ratio, although specific values and units are not indicated. There are three lines on the graph, each representing a different condition: the dashed blue line corresponds to the condition labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.85," the dashed green line to "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," and the solid orange dashed line to "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33." The blue dashed line shows a rapid decline from the start of the x-axis, indicating a decrease in sparsity ratio over time. The green dashed line follows a similar trend but with a slight delay in the start of the decline. The orange dashed line also shows a decline but with a more erratic pattern, including some fluctuations and an overall lower sparsity ratio compared to the other two lines. Specific data points, peaks, or troughs are not annotated on the graph.
model_annotations.English: The line plot depicts the sparsity ratio measured before a certain gate, after the gate, and after an average gate over a series of events. The x-axis, which likely represents time or stages in a process, is unlabeled in scale or units but shows a progression from left to right. The y-axis, also unlabeled, presumably indicates the sparsity ratio values. The solid blue line represents the sparsity ratio before the gate and is characterized by a steep decline across the plot, starting from an unspecified high value and ending at a lower value, indicating a decrease over time. Specifically, the line starts and ends at 0.00. The dashed orange line represents the sparsity ratio after the gate, starting from approximately 1.00 and ending near 0.1, showcasing a significant decrease. The dotted green line represents the sparsity ratio after the average gate, initiating around 1.00 and finishing about 0.33. All three lines exhibit downward trends, implying that the sparsity ratio decreases with each proceeding event. The chart does not provide axes labels or data values, thus specific values and descriptions of trends are based on visual interpretations.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm veransacht die Dynamik der Sparsgetreide über die Zeit, wobei die X-Achse keine abgeleiteten Informationen beinhaltet. Stattdessen spannt die Y-Achse sich von geringfügigem zum signifikant niedrigeren Wert und weist minimalen Fluktuation bei einer spektralen Basis hin, die geringfügig niedriger ist als der Gleichwertmassalurteil (Kronecker-Modus). Das Diagramm verliert etwas des Standards in Bezug auf andere Arten von Darstellungen, wie Transkriptprofile, was die feinen Nuancen der vielschichtigen Variabilität verbirgt, die etwas komplex aufgebaut ist. Das Diagramm ist eher eine spiel von Verzierungen und stilistischen Entscheidungen, die unerwartete Nuancen in den Datentext offenbaren und eine spezifische Vorstellung von Maßgeblichkeit schaffen, die nicht festgelegte Standards überschreitet.
